This [[item]] cannot be used in [[PvP]].}} ==Acquisition== ; During [[April Fools' Day]] * From the chest spawning when killing the worm queen during [[Annihilator 2: Searing Day]]. ; During [[Anniversary Celebration]]s * In exchange for 10 [[Victory Token]]s from [[Elite Xunlai Agent Isa Ku]]. * Random [[drop]] by [[PvE]] [[foe]]s. ==Collectors== {{:Lieutenant Thackeray/Collector}} == Trivia == * The flame on top of the candle is animated. * The animation that occurs on a character eating a cupcake is the same animation as those hexed with [[Soothing Images]] or [[Madness Dart]]s. * Eating cupcakes is the only way to obtain a speed boost in [[explorable area]]s of [[Ascalon (pre-Searing)]]; none of the skills or other consumables will increase the player's speed. * Cupcakes were also available from [[Victory Token]] collectors during [[Dragon Festival 2009]], [[Canthan New Year 2010]], [[Dragon Festival 2010]], and [[Feedback:Game updates/20110630|the first day]] of [[Dragon Festival 2011]]. * Prior to the introduction of [[Elite Xunlai Agent Isa Ku]] in the [[Seventh Year Anniversary Celebration]], [[Sheng Yi]] and [[Zaishen Supply Master]] also offered cupcakes during [[Anniversary Celebration]]s for 10 Victory Tokens. * According to the [https://web.archive.org/web/20130908165107/http://www.guildwars.com/community/thescribe/scribe-070425.php April 25, 2007 issue of the Scribe], these were first baked by [[Imperial Chef Tian]] for the [[Second Birthday Celebration]]. ==External links== *[https://web.archive.org/web/20130905094814/http://www.guildwars.com/events/ingame/birthday2k7/default.php Official announcement (archive)] *[https://web.archive.org/web/20130908165107/http://www.guildwars.com/community/thescribe/scribe-070425.php The Scribe #39 (archive)] *[[w:Cupcake|Wikipedia's Cupcake article]] {{Sweets nav}} [[Category:Sweets]] [[Category:April Fools' Day items]] [[Category:Anniversary Celebration items]]
